official_sources.source_identity: Gravity Wiz first-party product update naming Gravity Perks v2.3.17
Spellbook documentation describing replacement of the Gravity Perks platform plugin

capability_observations.summary: Gravity Perks v2.3.17 fixes Spellbook activation during migration, while current first-party Spellbook documentation states that Spellbook has replaced the Gravity Perks platform plugin and assumes installation/update responsibility. This materially changes parent delivery/platform identity without proving anything about the exact localization package PersianGravity currently admits.

If a newer Owner package or Spellbook-era parent authority is supplied, PersianGravity should reconcile the exact package/domain/source identity before changing its existing Gravity Perks localization admission. Child perks remain separate explicit profiles and are not enrolled by this radar.
